findings.evidence: English is a noun phrase naming a count; the imperative 'keep unused installations' beside a number field reads as a command and loses 'how many'. Precedent in the same file: network_audit_generations 'Audit generations kept' → 'محفوظ آڈٹ جنیریشنز'.

Plural 'پچھلی … انسٹالیشنز' can read as 'earlier installs' in general (what prune deletes). The English 'current, previous and running installs' has the same structure and ambiguity, so this mirrors the source; the 146-cell guarantee budget (34 cells spare) leaves little room to disambiguate.
